description: Make the rover "say" a text on the Face Display module (128×64 OLED): a small rover face with a talking mouth and the text typed out in a speech bubble (Thai supported, ~11 characters per line, 2 lines per bubble, extra bubbles follow). Returns to the big face after `seconds`, or once every bubble has been shown if that takes longer.
name: display_text
title: Show text on the display
